component.name: Opacra Wallet
component.summary: Wallet for Opacra (OPCA), a private, CPU-mined coin

description.p: Opacra is a private coin with its own blockchain, built on Monero's code. Every payment hides the sender, the receiver and the amount.

This wallet sends and receives OPCA, mines with your processor, and lets you prove a payment or a balance to someone you choose. Your 25 words are the only backup of your wallet: write them down and keep them offline.
